description: Planetary transit (Gochara) snapshot for a given date vs the natal chart. Returns that day's panchanga (vara, tithi+rikta, nakshatra, yoga, karana, paksha), muhurta windows (sunrise/sunset, Abhijit plus a clean Abhijit with Rahu/Gulika/Yamaganda overlap removed, and the avoid windows), all 9 planets (sign, degree, nakshatra/pada, retrograde, combust, house from Moon and Lagna, Ashtakavarga bindus, Gochara-phala favourable/Vedha), and the native's Tara Bala (Moon/Sun/Lagna), Chandra Bala and Sade Sati. Also returns the transit moment's D-1 (Rasi) and D-9 (Navamsa) charts under 'transit_charts' — each planet plus the Ascendant with sign and longitude. Rahu/Ketu use the Mean node by default; pass node_type='true' for True nodes. Data only — no verdict.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

event_place.description: Event place name (optional; defaults to birth place)

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

include.description: Enrichment sections: 'ashtakavarga', 'gochara_phala', 'transit_charts' (default all three). Pass [] for lean.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: get_gochara
title: Transit Snapshot (Gochara)
